why: The announcement latch is read but never spent, so one level switch freezes interpolation for the rest of the session: every tank is drawn on its current-tick pose forever after and motion becomes a 60 Hz stutter. This is the same failure `render-respawn-teleport-applied-to-every-tank` describes from the per-tank side, reached from the world side instead, and no single-sync assertion anywhere in the file can see it -- it takes a sync that consumes the announcement followed by an ordinary one that must still interpolate.
killedBy: entity views — interpolation discontinuities spends the level-switch announcement on one sync, then interpolates again
